headline: Waist-high SSE junk on a marginal angle — dawn patrol or don't bother.
today: Short-period windswell at a bad angle for us, so it's mushy and shapeless. The WSW cross stays light through the morning before the SW cross-on fills in after noon and the SSY onshore trashes it by evening. Log or groveler at dawn around the outgoing tide is your only real shot. Nothing to rearrange your day for.

daysToWatch.note: Cleanest winds of the week with cross-off WNW all day turning offshore by evening, but the swell's tiny at knee-to-waist. Glassy leftovers, log it.
Flat and cranking NW cross-off 16-19mph. Skip it.
Still flat, still windy out of the NW. Not worth checking.
